claims.assertion: Swaruu says helping is a personal choice, not an assigned mission; she advises helpers to stop when it harms them.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes this as her perspective.

claims.assertion: Yazhí says positive nonhuman races serve as guides and teachers; the work of learning remains with humans.
claims.speaker: Yazhí
claims.qualifiers: She compares intervention to solving a student’s exam.

claims.assertion: Yazhí says nearly all biological incarnations occur in 5D rather than 3D; 3D offers a different set of experiences.
claims.speaker: Yazhí
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as a broad tendency.
